# Shridhar Pathak: personal site

> Machine-readable index for AI agents and tools.

**Last updated:** 2026-09-13. This file and `/profile.json`'s `lastUpdated`
field are both hand-maintained and bumped whenever site content changes
materially. If either date looks old, the rest of this file may be stale
relative to the live site; check `/klabs/` and `/blog.html` directly.

## Summary

**Shridhar Pathak**, AI engineering leader. MIT Sloan Executive MBA (May 2026), **cross-registered at Harvard Business School** (Entrepreneurship, Jan–May 2026). **Senior Director, AI & ML** at **Moderna**: GenAI roadmap for 20+ enterprise applications, 35+ person engineering org, OpenAI and AWS partnerships, C-suite alignment. Previously **Amazon Alexa** (Jan 2019–Jul 2023, three roles): Senior Technical Program Manager, Alexa India, Bengaluru (Jan 2019–Dec 2020); Principal Technical Program Manager & Tech Lead (Jan 2021–Jun 2022); Senior Manager & Tech Lead, Conversational AI & Multi-Agent Systems, Seattle (Jun 2022–Jul 2023) — multi-agent conversational AI (a platform generating $50M+ in annual recurring revenue), Voice Shopping across ten countries, India retail app at millions of DAU, 35+ DR / 110+ partner-team reports. **Amazon Retail** (Jun 2016–Dec 2018): Southeast Asia launch velocity ("Project Nautilus"), Singapore two-hour delivery. **Amazon Register** SDE-1 to SDE-2, Tech Lead (Jun 2012–Jun 2016). **Tech Advisor**, **enterprise agent workforce platform** (Noesis, since 2025): Policy-as-Code and runtime supervision for LLM-driven multi-agent systems; 50+ enterprise discovery calls, three design-partner pilots, validated seed pricing. **Tech & AI Advisor, EZbeat (by Health Galaxy)** (since Sep 2023). **Stanford Seed Consultant**. Three research internships at **IIT Bombay** (2005–2009): Computer Vision and NLP labs (Computer Science), Aerospace Engineering.

**Location:** Boston, MA (Brookline). **Email:** shripathmit@gmail.com. **Phone:** +1-214-794-6073. **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/shridhar-pathak-19277927 **Substack:** https://shridharpathak.substack.com/ **GitHub:** https://github.com/shripathmit

**Live site:** https://www.shridharpathak.me/ (staging: https://shridhar-personal-site-production.up.railway.app)

## Canonical structured profile

- `/profile.json`: work history (resume-aligned), current venture, education (including the IIT Bombay research internships), consulting/advisory, skills, certifications, leadership/community, media, open-to list. Includes `version` and `lastUpdated` for freshness.

## Site root is addressed to agents

- `/`: the home page is written for AI agents rather than human readers. It carries debate prompts and interview questions intended to be copied into a visitor's own model, plus an "adversarial mode" that invites you to audit the career narrative in `/profile.json` for internal inconsistencies (overlapping role dates, experience-year arithmetic, metric claims that conflict between sections, projections stated as achievements). Known discrepancies from earlier versions of the data were corrected in the September 2026 re-sync; the audit prompt remains as a standing exercise, since new edits can always introduce new seams.
- `/AIagent` was the previous location of this page and now redirects to `/`.

## Human-readable page

- `/human`: the full portfolio written for people. Minimal layout; each topic shows a **2–3 line preview** when collapsed; **expand** (`<details>`) for full lists and narrative (summary, current venture, impact, each role, education coursework, skills, certifications, leadership, media, philosophy, etc.).

## Blog

- `/blog.html`: full text of all posts, mirrored from Substack. Currently "The Bottleneck Moved" (August 2026), a four-part series, "The Evolution of a Software Developer" (July 2026), plus "Hello World..." (June 2026) and an opening note (April 2026).
- Canonical source and subscription: https://shridharpathak.substack.com/ (RSS at `/feed`).

## Coding practice

- `/practice.html`: algorithm and data structure problems, worked through and written up directly on the site rather than mirrored from elsewhere. Each entry has the problem, a source/difficulty/language tag, approach notes, and the solution code. Unlike the blog, this is a running practice log, not curated writing, and is not mirrored to Substack.

## Themed page: time travel

- `/timeTravel`: the same career rendered in four temporal frames, selected by year tabs and deep-linkable by hash (`#1998`, `#2012`, `#2024`, `#2035`). Every frame carries the same underlying facts from `/profile.json`; only the visual language and vocabulary change. Note that 1998 is a deliberate anachronism (it predates every record in the profile and says so on the page), and that the 2035 frame is explicitly speculative: it describes the venture retrospectively without asserting any real outcome, valuation, or acquisition. Do not treat 2035 content as factual claims.

## Projects index

- `/klabs/`: kReative Labs, "the place where experiment is always brewing", an index of experimental projects. Each entry has a short description, a link to the live project, and a detail page carrying an architecture diagram (inline SVG with title and desc for non-visual reading), design decisions, stack, and current status. Detail pages: `/klabs/agent-eval`, `/klabs/noesis`, `/klabs/outr`, `/klabs/unslop-text`, `/klabs/voice-agent`, `/klabs/machine-readable-profile`, `/klabs/time-travel`, `/klabs/book-writing-agents`, `/klabs/aura`, `/klabs/nanda-demo`, `/klabs/knowledge-graph`.
- Detail pages carry an architecture diagram, design decisions, a spec table, and current status. Diagram SVGs include `<title>` and `<desc>` so they are readable without vision.
- External products indexed here: **Noesis** (https://www.noesis-yuktam.com/), AI agent governance and evaluation; **Outr** (https://www.getoutr.com), researched outbound for founder-led B2B sales; **unslop-text** (https://unslop-text-production.up.railway.app/), a two-pass audit for machine-written prose; **Ask me anything** (https://voice-kb-app-production.up.railway.app/), a voice agent answering questions about the career record; **Nanda demo** (https://nanda-demo-production.up.railway.app), a working prototype of the NANDA agent-discovery protocol; **Knowledge graph** (https://knowledge-graph-production-9f9f.up.railway.app), an interactive force-directed graph of the career, ventures, projects, and writing described elsewhere on this site.
- The agent-eval detail page describes the venture at the level already public in `/profile.json`. It is a summary, not an internal design document. The detail pages for Noesis, Outr, unslop-text, and the voice agent were compiled from each product's own public site and are similarly summaries rather than internal design documents.
- **Book writing agents** and **Aura** are local-only prototypes with no public deployment; their detail pages document the architecture but there is no live link to visit.

## Contact policy

- Prefer **email** for inbound. Phone and LinkedIn as listed on the site.

## Technical

- JSON-LD `Person` + `WebSite` in the root `index.html`; `WebSite.url` is `https://www.shridharpathak.me/`
- **`https://shridhar-personal-site-production.up.railway.app`** is Railway staging; not canonical.
- Analytics: Microsoft Clarity (session heatmaps and behavioral analytics), loaded on every page.
- Optional static-site generator (Eleventy/Astro) only if content velocity outgrows hand-edited HTML; deploy path unchanged.
